0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>This lionhearted hunter would see what an ally of Ronka is made of.

29.original: Speak with the lionhearted hunter again.

30.original: Speak with the lionhearted hunter one last time.

48.original: You there, perhaps you can accompany me on a patrol of the wood.

49.original: As an ally of Ronka, it may serve you well to see how we Viis ensure the safety of our sacred sites. Do you not agree?

50.original: Splendid! Very well, we begin at once. I shall await you at Bowrest.

51.original: Shhh! We must be quiet. Look there, in the brush. A pair of afflicted does seeks refuge, but they cannot escape their fate. I shall draw them out─you do the rest.

52.original: Do not hesitate! Your prey is before you!

53.original: What skill! Truly you are worthy of your title. I only said your prey was weakened to embolden you, but it appears that was unnecessary.

54.original: Well then, let us proceed. You have proven your mettle, so it would be best for us to patrol separate routes from now on.

55.original: Look after the area near the Wild Fete. I shall depart to the Morning Stars.

56.original: Once you have finished, meet back here. Be safe.

57.original: An arrow pierces the hide of the caracal. It appears to have fallen in a single shot.

58.original: You are returned already. I take it your patrol was as uneventful as mine.

59.original: What? A single arrow? Impossible...can it be?

61.original: Did you hear that? From deep in the wood...someone crying out for help. She may be in danger─we must help!

62.original: As we feared, she was attacked. Luckily, a Watcher struck down her aggressor before she came to any serious harm. An uncommon occurrence, but it is not unheard of to see one while they are hunting.

63.original: Doubtless the caracal you sighted was his doing as well. He must have fled into the wood when you arrived.

64.original: At any rate, we must treat her. Let us return to Fanow.

65.original: That was quite eventful for a first patrol. To think that you would meet one of the wood's Watchers.

66.original: Hmm, perhaps 'meet' is not the right word. If only I could have introduced you as one of Ronka's allies. Alas, it seems that our guardian had other plans.

67.original: The day was far from a disappointment, however. With your help we were able to guide a wounded ally to safety. You are welcome to join me again any time you wish.
